title: Read data about college completers from one zipped file — read_completers
text: version table enumerates students level award race/ethnicity, gender age categories. file contains multiple records per institution. record uniquely defined variables IPEDS ID (UNITID) award level (AWLEVELC ). 'C' stripped "AWLEVELC" post-read processing. record contain: total number students receiving awards number  men women receiving awards number students receiving awards nine race/ethnicity categories; number students receiving awards also available following age groups: 18 18-24 25-39 40 . Numbers available combinations race, gender age. Beginning 2019-20, certificate less 1 year replaced following 2 categories: certificates less 12 weeks certificates least 12-weeks less-1-year.
